name: When Cori Grows Up
source:
Cori is a happy go-lucky, 10-year old elementary school student. One Monday morning, her teacher, Miss Debra Downer gives the class an important assignment; the students must pick a career they like to present on Career Day on Friday!

Throughout the week, Cori encounters people from all backgrounds with different careers, some that Cori like, and some Cori definitely doesn't like. And some careers Cori never even thought of! Help Cori figure out which career she likes and present it to the class for Career Day.

[From [url=https://dororochi.itch.io/when-cori-grows-up]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Cori是一名无忧无虑的10岁小学生。一个星期一早上，她的老师黛布拉·唐纳小姐给全班布置了一项重要的作业：学生们必须选择一个他们喜欢的职业，在周五的职业日上展示！

在这一周里，科里遇到了来自不同背景、不同职业的人，有些是科里喜欢的，有些是科里绝对不喜欢的。还有一些科里从未想过的职业！帮助Cori找出她喜欢的职业，并在职业日向全班展示。

[来自[url=https://dororochi.itch.io/when-cori-grows-up]itch.io[/url]]
